note: Rejudged 2026-10-24 by an independent auditor (authored none of it) after 690c96d6bf and c660756f9d. RFC 7311 Section 3.4.3, rfc/full/rfc7311.txt:524-530: "Any change due to (a) in any of these values MUST trigger a new AIGP computation for that route." (a) is "the AIGP TLV values of all the next hops that are recursively resolved during this procedure"; (b), the IGP distance to a next hop that is not recursively resolved, is left to a configurable threshold and is not this row. The weak finding of 2026-10-23 was that a route withheld for an unknown or zero cost was never recovered toward a destination that never held it, because noteAIGPWrite recorded the recipient only from the withdrawal the final writer drops, and no carrier could see it. 690c96d6bf fixes the producer (writeUpdateBody records the unfiltered cost-withheld withdrawal, add-only, before the adj-out filter; flushWrites commits it), so the recompute path readvertiseAIGP now reaches every recipient for both (a) and (b) triggers. c660756f9d (owner-approved) restores the never-advertised start in TestRFC7311ExtendedNextHopCostRecovery: 16- and 32-octet IPv6 next hop, no frame on withhold, then exactly withheldFrames+1 UPDATEs, the last with MP_REACH carrying the negotiated IPv6 self hop and the original NLRI and AIGP exactly 111 with flags 0x80; the advertised-first start keeps its exact legacy or MP withdrawal. The (a) obligation itself is proven by the byte-identical carriers TestRFC7311RecursiveAIGPChangeReachesWire (recursive next hop AIGP changes reach the wire as exact sums without a new source UPDATE, finite recovery after saturation from the original received value) and TestRFC7311ReceivedRecursiveAIGPChangeReachesWire (received AIGP-only replacement of the immediate or deeper recursive next hop reaches the dependent route, exact 1107 and the control prefix untouched at 30), plus TestRFC7311RecursiveZeroCostRemainsAnnounced (a recursive next hop's AIGP 7 replaced by 0 must stay announced with the recomputed value, never withdrawn) and the byte-identical TestAIGPRecursiveDistanceUsesReceivedMetrics and TestAIGPDistanceChangeReselectsRetainedRoutes, whose 2026-10-12 judgement stands; not recomputing on an (a) change leaves the old metric on the wire and fails those exact-value waits. FINDING (attribution, not a red): TestRFC7311ExtendedNextHopCostRecovery triggers the recompute with a Loc-RIB IGP distance of 11 (a (b) change), so its -7 tags prove the shared recompute and recovery machinery rather than the (a) clause; Ze recomputing on every (b) change is a threshold of zero, which the RFC permits. Fix: retag it to the (b) sentence or name the shared recompute path in their claim; the (a) proof does not rest on them. Verdict enforced because the (a) carriers assert exact recomputed values and the recovery defect behind the earlier weak verdict is fixed and now asserted. Ran 2026-10-24: go test -run 'RFC7311|AIGPCostWithheld' ./internal/component/bgp/reactor/ ok.
